Columns: overdispersion, position bias, cyclic, pair-specific; top row Δ (deletion filled, flip open) with the margin band; bottom row the SE ratio. It draws both synthetic graphs of `positive_control.csv` (MT-Bench human, all sizes; Arena-55k, one size per departure). Data are synthetic, and the figure says so in the provenance JSON; the caption must say so too.
  > 
  > What the figure shows that `control_table.tex` does not: the Arena-55k flip Δ sits at 0.045 with no departure at all (the method's offset), so the real Arena-55k flip 0.056 is mostly that offset.
  > 
  > **Fig. 4 changed too:** panel A now marks the no-departure Δ of the same-graph simulation for Arena-55k and MT-Bench human (black tick, legend "synthetic, no departure"). Caption needs one clause: "black tick: Δ on data simulated from the fitted model of that graph with no departure (Appendix X)". Fig. 4 is still included at 0.86\linewidth.
  > 
  > Placement is yours. The main text is full at page 9 (the C4 claim "Δ is not a test of misfit" now rests on an appendix table). If a main float cannot be spared, Fig. 6 goes before `control_table` in Appendix C and the main text points to it. If you can spare ~2.9 in in §5.3, Fig. 6 is the one that carries the claim at a glance. I do not regenerate `control_table.tex`; it is yours.
